name: Chowka at The Aodhi
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine restaurant inside The Aodhi, the HRH Group's heritage-style hill resort tucked into the Kumbhalgarh ridge — the chef's Mewari menu is the regional citation. Poolside dinners and banquets in the dry season.
insider_tip: Aodhi sits below the fort's main gate — combine an early dinner at Chowka with the fort's evening light-and-sound show; the resort can arrange the transfer.
signature_address: The Aodhi, Kumbhalgarh, Rajsamand District, Rajasthan 313325

name: The Kumbha Bagh Multi-Cuisine Restaurant
why_it_matters: Resort restaurant 200 m from Kumbhalgarh Fort, perched at 3,500 ft — multi-cuisine kitchen with traditional decor and on-request à la carte. The closest paid dining to the fort entrance.
insider_tip: Order the special 'chef's request' dish a few hours ahead — they will prep regional items not on the standard menu if given lead time.
signature_address: The Kumbha Bagh, near Kumbhalgarh Fort, Rajsamand District, Rajasthan 313325

name: Jeeman at Club Mahindra Kumbhalgarh
why_it_matters: All-day multi-cuisine restaurant on the first floor of Club Mahindra Kumbhalgarh — Mewari menu is the actual reason to come, with gutta curry, ker sangri, panchkuta, pitod ki sabzi and methi-papad ki sabzi cooked to recipe. The upstairs Barbeque Bay opens for dinner only.
insider_tip: Skip the international section of the buffet and order the Mewari thali à la carte — the kitchen's strength is the regional list, not the global one.
signature_address: Club Mahindra Kumbhalgarh Resort, Kumbhalgarh, Rajsamand District, Rajasthan 313325
